subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**opens**" means to cause something to be accessible or available. (खोलता है)
 
• In the context, literacy is described as the "golden key" that makes new opportunities and knowledge available, which aligns well with "opens."
 
• The other options: "**controls**," "**leads**," and "**closes**" do not fit the metaphor of a key unlocking something valuable. "Controls" would imply regulation; "leads" suggests guiding to a destination; and "closes" is the opposite of what literacy does.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *What is literacy? It is the golden key that opens__ the gates to a whole new world.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Controls (नियंत्रित)**: means to regulate or command. It does not fit the metaphor of a key unlocking something.
 
• **Leads (प्रमुख)**: means to guide or direct. It implies direction rather than accessibility or availability.
 
• **Closes (बंद)**: means to shut. It is the opposite of what literacy is intended to do in this metaphor.
